source: Switch Transformer simplified the routing algorithm further. Instead of Top-2, each token was sent to the single expert with the highest router probability. The authors reported three practical motivations: less routing work, smaller expert capacity requirements, and reduced communication complexity.
zh: Switch Transformer 进一步简化了路由算法。每个令牌都被发送给具有最高路由器概率的单个专家，而不是 Top-2。作者报告了三个实际动机：减少路由工作、减少专家能力要求以及降低通信复杂性。
